shortBio.en: Interpol vocalist and multi-instrumentalist; Turn On the Bright Lights–era baritone.
shortBio.zh: Interpol 主唱与多乐器手；《Turn On the Bright Lights》时期的男中音。

body.en: Born 1978. Lead vocals for Interpol from the New York post-punk revival lineup. Shares bass and guitar duties across records.
body.zh: 1978 年生。纽约后朋克复兴编制起任 Interpol 主唱。唱片上分担贝斯与吉他。
